points.point: Why the DM automation does not fire after a friend's comment with PDF
Customer already tried a friend's account and it still fails
No run appears in automation runs and logs (account-specific fact)

verdict.reason: The customer says they already tried a different account and it still fails, and the runs and logs show nothing, which is a fact only their own account can show, so this is not for an entry to answer; the closest entry (dm-automation-own-comment) covers only commenting from the connected account, not a friend's account that still fails.
